map.宫外孕(hCG动态)风险评估器 使用指南: Ectopic-pregnancy (hCG dynamics) risk assessor - User Guide
map.输入两次 hCG 检测值与间隔时间，计算倍增时间并对照阈值(初始<1500时48: Enter two hCG readings and the interval to compute doubling time and compare thresholds (initial <1500: >=66% rise in 48h is intrauterine), distinguishing intrauterine vs ectopic pregnancy risk.
map.变化率 = (hCG₂ − hCG₁) / hCG₁ × 100%；倍增时间 D: Rate of change = (hCG2 - hCG1) / hCG1 * 100%; doubling time DT = interval * ln2 / ln(hCG2/hCG1)
map.正常宮内孕婚 48h hCG 增幅≥ 66%（3000）；≤ 正常下限需警惕异位: Normal intrauterine pregnancy: 48h hCG rise >= 66% (up to 3000); <= lower normal limit warrants vigilance for ectopic pregnancy.
map.早孕期间隔 48 小时测 hCG，判断倍增是否符合宫内妊娠。: In early pregnancy measure hCG every 48 hours to judge whether doubling fits an intrauterine pregnancy.
map.hCG 上升不足或下降时排查异位妊娠/先兆流产。: When hCG rise is insufficient or declines, rule out ectopic pregnancy / threatened miscarriage.
map.hCG 达 2000 mIU/mL 后行阴道超声确认孕囊位置。: After hCG reaches 2000 mIU/mL, perform transvaginal ultrasound to confirm gestational-sac location.
map.：首次 1000 mIU/mL、48 小时后 2000 mIU/mL：增幅 10: : first 1000 mIU/mL, 48h later 2000 mIU/mL: rise 100% >= 48h minimum 53%, doubling time = 48*0.693/ln(2) ~ 48h, fitting normal intrauterine pregnancy.
map.：首次 1500、48 小时后 1900（增幅 26.7%）：低于 53% 下限: : first 1500, 48h later 1900 (rise 26.7%): below the 53% lower limit; beware ectopic pregnancy or poor embryonic development; retest hCG and transvaginal ultrasound.

map.48 小时 hCG 要涨多少才正常？: How much should hCG rise in 48 hours to be normal?
map.宫内妊娠通常 48h 增幅 ≥53%（即倍增时间约 48h 内）；低于此但 >3: Intrauterine pregnancy usually rises >=53% in 48h (doubling time within ~48h); below that but >35% is borderline, retest needed; a decline suggests miscarriage or ectopic.
map.hCG 多高该看到孕囊？: How high should hCG be before a gestational sac is visible?
map.阴道超声一般在 hCG ≥2000 mIU/mL 可见宫内孕囊；若此水平仍未见且: Transvaginal ultrasound usually shows an intrauterine sac at hCG >= 2000 mIU/mL; if still unseen at this level with abnormal hCG rise, ectopic risk is high.
